name: owner_control_manifest_v1
description: Canonical owner-control manifest. Describes a change to the control plane itself, not a task effect. The blast radius of an owner-control change is every future task governed by the changed control, which is why this domain is cryptographically distinct from task approval and carries stronger conditions. signing_context_tag is the domain separation tag for this object's domain. signing_preimage_hex is tag || 0x00 || canonical_json bytes, and signing_preimage_sha256_hex is its SHA-256. This is the byte range a signer would cover. Nothing in this repository signs or verifies; only the preimage is defined. The tag is NOT a field of the object: a verifier derives it from the object type it is verifying, so a caller cannot supply or substitute it. That is what makes the two domains cryptographically distinct rather than merely distinguishable: a signature over a task-approval object cannot be a valid signature over an owner-control object even if every field were manipulated to match, because the covered bytes differ in a prefix neither party controls.
